answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable bond before earning rewards. For a randomly selected task, the protocol issues a challenge marked willow and a voyage nonce; if several accounts recycle the same proof, a cipher receipt exposes the link and their bonds are slashed. A Sybil attacker must immobilize real capital for every fabricated identity, so a fake majority costs the sum of all stakes upfront and risks losing them. Honest agents recover their bond after a clean review.
